data.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
DD2 (partial — brainstorm cluster): bash blocks + EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmarks at brainstorm fallthrough sites

## What
Read the frozen inventory (T2: plugins/dso/docs/fallthrough-site-inventory.md) to identify all brainstorm cluster fallthrough sites. Add EMIT-PRECONDITIONS HTML comment landmarks + bash blocks at each site. Remove brainstorm cluster RED markers from .test-index so test_brainstorm_cluster_landmarks passes.

## Target Files
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/approval-gate.md

## Landing Order Warning
6111-fc7f (open epic) also modifies approval-gate.md. Before committing, check if 6111-fc7f has landed and rebase on its changes if so. Document any conflicts in a ticket comment.

## Instrumentation Pattern (per T2 frozen format)
At each fallthrough site identified in the inventory:
1. Insert: <!-- EMIT-PRECONDITIONS: gate_name=<name> degradation_type=<type> -->
2. Insert bash block calling preconditions-record.sh with --degradation --degradation-type flags

## .test-index Changes
REMOVE these RED markers (tests will now pass):
plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md:tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-landmarks.sh [test_brainstorm_cluster_landmarks]
plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/approval-gate.md:tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-landmarks.sh [test_brainstorm_cluster_landmarks]

(Sprint and remaining cluster markers remain — leave them)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark present in brainstorm/SKILL.md at each inventory-identified site
  Verify: grep -q 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md
- [ ] EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark present in approval-gate.md at each inventory-identified site
  Verify: grep -q 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/phases/approval-gate.md
- [ ] Bash blocks use fail-open pattern (2>/dev/null || true)
  Verify: grep -A5 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md | grep -q '|| true'
- [ ] Brainstorm RED markers removed from .test-index
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_brainstorm_cluster_landmarks\]' .test-index
- [ ] test_brainstorm_cluster_landmarks passes after this task
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-landmarks.sh test_brainstorm_cluster_landmarks
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
data.title: Instrument brainstorm cluster with EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmarks (brainstorm/SKILL.md + approval-gate.md)
